method: Built-in image generation, then deterministic format/size exports
icon_prompt: Refine approved silver turbine G and blue S; preserve silhouette; improve polished edges, turbine detail and alpha transparency.
banner_prompt: Enhance supplied navy/silver/cyan GS Engineering banner; preserve logo, aircraft, clouds and exact wording.
header_prompt: Adapt banner to 9.6:1 slim full-page header with complete logo and lettering.
export_note: Exports larger than native dimensions are resampled; native masters are included. Slim headers preserve the complete centrally composed strip with navy side padding, without stretching the logo.
